question: What minimum off-roadway sizes does Table 9A-1 give for a STOP sign, a YIELD sign, and a Crossbuck sign on a bicycle facility?
model_answer: Direct Answer: For signs installed specifically on bicycle facilities (off-roadway applications), Table 9A-1 gives a minimum size of 18 x 18 inches for the STOP (R1-1) sign, 18 x 18 x 18 inches for the YIELD (R1-2) sign, and 24 x 4.5 inches for the Grade Crossing (Crossbuck, R15-1) sign. These are the minimum sizes that must be used for bicyclist-specific installations. Standards (mandatory): - "The minimum sign and plaque sizes for signs specific to bicycle-only facilities and shared-use paths shall be those shown in Table 9A-1. These sizes shall be used only for signs and plaques installed specifically for bicyclist applications." - Per Table 9A-1 (Sheet 1): Stop, R1-1, Section 9B.01, Off Roadway 18 x 18; Yield, R1-2, Section 9B.01, Off Roadway 18 x 18 x 18; Grade Crossing (Crossbuck), R15-1, Section 9B.23, Off Roadway 24 x 4.5. - Related requirement for temporary traffic control: "The minimum TTC sign and plaque sizes for shared-use paths shall conform to those shown in Table 9A-1." Guidance (recommended): - The quoted text of Table 9A-1 (Sheet 1) confirms the off-roadway entries "Stop R1-1 9B.01 18 x 18" and "Yield R1-2 9B.01 18 x 18 x 18." Visual evidence: - [Image 5] shows Table 9A-1, Sheet 1 of 3, listing the STOP (R1-1) off-roadway minimum as 18 x 18, the YIELD (R1-2) off-roadway minimum as 18 x 18 x 18, and the Grade Crossing (Crossbuck) (R15-1) off-roadway minimum as 24 x 4.5 (with 48 x 9 for roadway use). - [Image 2] shows Table 9A-1, Sheet 2 of 3, which covers warning and destination signs but does not contain the STOP, YIELD, or Crossbuck rows. - [Image 4] shows Figure 9B-1 (Sheet 1 of 2) illustrating the R1-1 STOP and R1-2 YIELD signs used on bicycle facilities. - [Image 3] shows Figure 9B-1 (Sheet 2 of 2) illustrating the R15-1 Crossbuck sign for bicycle facilities. Citations: - Section 9A.02 Standard §10 (p.1048) - Section 9A.03 Guidance §3 (p.1051) - Section 6N.04 Standard §19 (p.844) - Table 9A-1 (p.1036) - Page 1090 - Page 1091 - Page 1093 - Page 1094
gold_answer: STOP: 18 x 18 inches; YIELD: 18 x 18 x 18 inches; Crossbuck: 24 x 4.5 inches.
